quest.title: The Culling of the Worms: Demonstration
quest.description: With a roar from the Wenutslayer Cannon, the Wenut falls to the ground...

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Did you see that, Shriya? Our Wenutslayer Cannon is a game changer!

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: I wish all the supervisors who listened to our thesis defense could come and see this. This would cure them of their antiquated views!

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: So it really did go off without a hitch... I thought it was going to end up like Experimental Device No. 3...

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Ahem... Only from our failures do we learn to succeed. I'm no longer who I used to be.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How many accidents happened that year...? Well, anyway, this experiment was a success, and that's all that matters!

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Yeah, while the ball is rolling, maybe we should try it somewhere else!

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Eyewitness reports say that there are Wenut in this area numbering in the double-digits at the very least!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... double digits!? You're not gonna pick them off one by one, are you? That would take a really long time!

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Huh? What's the matter? If it's the maintenance of the Wenutslayer Cannon you're concerned about, you don't have to worry...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, wait, wait! It would take a long time to repeat this process over and over again. Even if the machine doesn't break down, we will!

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: Vinayak, not everyone can be jolted back to life after just smelling machine oil.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Really? Looks like wetware performance will have to be considered next time...

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's call it a day. With data from this full run and samples collected after the battle, I am one step closer to solving this puzzle.

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: Why the Wenut are behaving violently, abnormal environmental parameters... If we can figure that out, we might be able to get to the bottom of this mess.

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: Please give me one more day to do some research. By this time tomorrow, we should have the results.
